Entries.Text: Open the History tool: the loaded model's undo history, and the models that keep theirs.

The loaded model's undo history, oldest first. Click a step to go back to before it, or click a greyed-out (undone) step to redo up to it. A model you switch away from keeps its history here, so you can undo again after switching back.
Done steps, then undone steps in grey. The highlighted step is the model's current state.
Load a model to see its history.
Undo this step and the {0} steps from here to the latest (including this one).
Redo the {0} steps up to and including this one.

Models you switched away from in this view that keep their history. They stay in memory (with their drawables, out of the viewport) until loaded again, unloaded, or dropped to stay within the limit. Saved models are dropped before unsaved ones, oldest first. Dropping a model loses only its history; unsaved edits are kept.
How many models this view keeps with their history. 0 keeps none, so switching models clears the history.
None. Edit a model, then load another, and the first is kept here.
{0} undo and redo steps kept. * marks unsaved edits.
Reload the model here, with its history and selection.
Drop the model's history and free its memory.
Drop the model's history and free its memory. Its unsaved edits are kept and can still be saved; only undo is lost.
{0}: dropped its {1} history steps to stay within the kept-models limit (History tool).
{0}: dropped its {1} history steps kept in view {2}, because it is loaded in another view.
